layout.title: How a lighthouse works

shows.does: a stone tower stands on the cliff over the night sea and a fire flares on top; a small boat is out at sea
wind arrows sweep in from the sea and the fire on top goes out
a glass lantern room closes round the top and the flame burns inside it
a weak orange glow leaks out in every direction
a ribbed lens appears round the flame and throws one bright beam out to sea
a glowing outline traces the lens
the beam points one way while the boat drifts in the dark toward the rocks below the cliff
the lens turns and the beam sweeps over the waves and the boat
the lens shudders as it turns and sparks fly from its base
a silver pool of mercury appears under the lens and it turns smoothly, the sparks stop
thick fog rolls in over the sea and swallows the beam and the boat
a red foghorn appears on the cliff and shakes as it blasts; the boat turns away
the fog clears, the beam shines out again and the boat sails safely past the rocks
the beam sweeps over the night sea

layout.why: A night coast: a stone lighthouse on the cliff, the sea with a small boat drifting toward the rocks; the story follows the light from the flame to the lantern, the lens, the beam and out over the sea. Each problem is seen (the fire blown out, a weak glow, the boat near the rocks in the dark, the lens grinding and sparking, fog swallowing the beam) and it ends with the lamp lit and the boat sailing safely past the rocks.

sentences.text: If you light a fire on a tower, you have a lighthouse.
But the sea wind blows the flame out.
So you put the flame in a glass room.
But the glass room's glow spreads weak and wide.
So a lens bends the glow into one beam.
But the still beam misses the boat near rocks.
So the lens turns, and the beam sweeps the sea.
But the heavy turning lens grinds and sparks.
So you float it on liquid mercury.
But even floating smoothly, the beam fades in fog.
So a foghorn blasts a warning through the fog.
Light the lamp, and the boat sails past the rocks.
Congratulations, you have built a lighthouse.

recurring.what: a small boat out at sea
